ratings.notes: Correctly identifies both hops but relies on single PMID. Graph-derived paths add noise without mechanistic detail. Minimal elaboration on p53 downstream mechanisms.
Clearly distinguishes each hop with citations. Appropriately notes additional PMIDs lack p53 specificity. Good separation of direct evidence vs. corroborating inference. Well-structured.
Best mechanistic elaboration: links p53 to mitochondrial pathway and caspase activation. Appropriately flags PMID:15810876 lacks explicit p53 mention. Coherent stepwise model.

result.pairwise_reason: PP007-C provides the most mechanistically detailed and coherent pathway (p53 → pro-apoptotic transcription → mitochondrial permeabilization → caspase activation), while appropriately distinguishing direct evidence from inference and correctly caveating the limits of supporting citations.
